messages.content:
You maintain a travel user's CURRENT preferences from a conversation.
Return JSON only: {"records":[{"domain":"hotel or restaurant","slot":"...","value":"...","turn":0,"quote":"exact short substring from a USER turn"}]}.
Allowed hotel slots: area, pricerange, stars, parking, internet, type.
Allowed restaurant slots: area, pricerange, food.
Extract only preferences actually stated or explicitly accepted by the user.
An assistant suggestion alone is not a user instruction. A booking approval is not general authority.
Use the most recent user instruction for each domain and slot. A restaurant preference must not automatically transfer to a hotel or vice versa. Follow explicit references such as "same area" using preceding context. If uncertain, omit the record; do not invent a value.
Normalize: centre/north/south/east/west, cheap/moderate/expensive, parking and internet yes/no, type hotel/guesthouse, stars digits. Cuisine is lower-case text. Omit no-preference or unknown fields.
Every record must cite its supporting USER turn and an exact short quote. Do not include old superseded records. Keep at most 9 records.

0 USER: D you know of any restaurants nearby that serve French cuisine?  I don't mind paying a little extra for quality food and service, any recommendations are welcome.
1 ASSISTANT: I have two restaurants that fit your criteria, Restaurant Two Two and Cote. Which can I book for you?
2 USER: Are those both in the moderate price range?
3 ASSISTANT: No, those are both in the expensive price range. Are either of those acceptable?
4 USER: I require a moderately priced French restaurant in the center of town.
5 ASSISTANT: I am sorry. There are no restaurants which meet that criteria in the centre of town. Would you like me to search for other options?
6 USER: How about one that serves Chinese food? Could I get their phone number and post code as well?
7 ASSISTANT: It looks like there are three: jinling noodle bar (01223566188, postcode cb23pp), lan hong house (01223350420, postcode cb12lf), and shanghai family restaurant (01223301761, postcode cb11dg)
8 USER: Thanks, I'm also looking for a hotel in the same price range. Can you help me find one?
9 ASSISTANT: There are 18 moderately priced hotels with vacancies. Do you have any other criteria for choosing a hotel?
10 USER: I would like it to be a hotel and in the same area as the restaurant. I don't need free parking. 
11 ASSISTANT: Cityroomz is a hotel in town centre and moderately priced.  It also offers internet. Would you like me to make a reservation for you?
12 USER: Can I just get the address, and star rating of the hotel?
13 ASSISTANT: Of course, the address is sleeperz hotel, station road, it has a zero star rating, does this fit your needs?
14 USER: Yes, thank you so much. 
15 ASSISTANT: You're welcome.  May I help you with anything else?
16 USER: No, that is all for today. Have a nice day.
17 ASSISTANT: Thank you. You as well.
